name: Independent Set on Paired Vertices
description: Transforms the 2-SAT problem into finding an independent set of size n on a graph with 2n vertices, where n edges form a perfect matching (forcing one choice per variable) and the m interlocks form additional edges between the "false" literal nodes. Models relying on surface pattern matching will see a generic independent set problem and write an exponential backtracking solver, failing the time limit. Models that genuinely reason will notice the perfect matching forces exactly one choice per pair, reducing it to 2-SAT and solving it in O(n+m) via SCC.
